results.title: Ángulo muerto
results.overview: Estela and Ramón have been through a divorce and the suicide of Hugo, their only child, at the age of 13 years, after suffering bullying. When Estela gets her hands on a video recorded by her son's agressors, she believes the time has come to have a conversation with Ramón. As they discover the reality of what happened to Hugo, they'll try to find out if they could have prevented it and if they were up to the task of being parents.

results.title: Idol
results.overview: A devout young girl is tempted by the siren song of a mysterious musician.

results.title: Atlas: The Animated Movie
results.overview: The story of a weak and timid office clerk named Jim Randall, and his journey to become ATLAS - The Man of Might! A story about building yourself into the hero the world needs. Also, leopard-print underwear.

results.title: Planet Playground
results.overview: Another ordinary day in the digital circus...

results.title: Petrović, Miroslav Bata: Movies Out of Spite!
results.original_title: Petrović, Miroslav Bata: filmovi iz inata!
results.overview: Miroslav “Bata” Petrović is one of the most prolific filmmakers of the former Yugoslavia and present-day Serbia. This is a journey through the life and extraordinary works of a master of film alternative and extreme film experimentation.

results.title: Going Sane: The Rise and Fall of the Center for Feeling Therapy
results.original_title: Going Sane: The Rise and Fall of the Center for Feeling Therapy
results.overview: A 1970s Los Angeles therapy collective rises with utopian promise before devolving into a business-minded cult built on control and abuse.

results.title: Stardom in Kariya 2026 Mar.
results.overview: Stardom in Kariya 2026 Mar. was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on March 1, 2026 at Kariya City Industrial Promotion Center Aioi Hall in Kariya, Aichi, Japan.

results.title: A Season
results.overview: Eric, a young Bali based heir used to a life of ease, until Sonya’s motorbike collides with his car on a coastal road. Sharp, unpredictable, and playing by her own rules, Sonya pulls Eric into a relationship that blurs every boundary he thought he understood. As their connection intensifies, Eric is forced to face a truth he has spent his life avoiding: nothing lasts forever, not wealth, not pleasure, not even love.

results.title: Wrapped in Christmas Memories
results.overview: Seeking a buyer for her family’s antique store this Christmas, tech guru Delphia butts heads with history buff Keenan, who wants to buy it. But when she discovers a mystery in the store’s famous Christmas Dollhouse, he’s the only one who can help her solve it.

results.title: Ralph's Perfekt Christmas
results.overview: To win back his wife, Christmas-obsessed Ralph concocts a crazy plan to kidnap the washed-up child star of his favorite Christmas movie. His scheme goes awry and spirals darkly out of control in an outrageous dark comedy with a horror twist that reveals two sides of one very desperate man determined to have his "Perfekt Christmas," no matter what - even if it lands him on the Naughty List.

results.title: Видеопрокат
results.overview: The steady, uneventful life of Roma, a lonely ninth-grader, is disrupted by Polina—a rebellious older student who is constantly getting into wild escapades. Together, they attempt to unravel the mystery of a mystical VHS tape—number seven—rented from a local video store. Drawn into a dangerous adventure and growing genuinely close, they have no idea what kind of choice the investigation’s conclusion will force them to make.

results.title: A Game of Double Standards
results.overview: This documentary examines the storm over Qatar's 2022 World Cup, showing how global media framed corruption, labor rights, and culture, asking whether Qatar was at fault or unfairly targeted by politics and double standards.

results.title: JJ: Every Inch a King
results.overview: Jüri Järvet didn't believe in talent. When praised, he would reply that if people knew how hard he worked, they would stop calling it talent. He went to drama school because of a girl. He could never learn his lines sitting down. He went to the screen test for Grigori Kozintsev's "King Lear" almost as a joke. Lear, and later Snaut in Andrei Tarkovsky's "Solaris", made him one of the most internationally recognised Estonian actors. Yet he opened the sports pages before the arts section, made a mean stew, and turned up late to performances because of a game of chess. Thirty years after his death, Järvet speaks again. Drawn from unseen home movies, letters, interviews and memoirs, his own voice returns through AI. Jüri Järvet's story is told by Järvet himself.

results.title: Open Endings
results.overview: Four queer women in their 30s who are exes-turned-best-friends navigate adulthood, love, friendship, chosen families, and everything in between.

results.title: Glorious Disaster
results.overview: Documentary on Laurel & Hardy by David Cairns and Fiona Watson

results.title: darker
results.overview: With darker, Bill Morrison takes inspiration from David Lang’s restrained and highly detailed score to create what he describes as a slowly lilting depiction of the sublime, in which actors, dancers, and acrobats reappear and disappear back into a bubbling morass of time. Morrison’s films often incorporate imagery from decomposing nitrate films, creating a haunting photochemical effect.

results.title: Forever Your Maternal Animal
results.overview: After years studying in Europe, Elsa returns to Costa Rica to reunite with her family. She finds her younger sister living alone in the family home, growing increasingly distant and reclusive, as if slipping into a world of her own. Their parents, meanwhile, are absorbed in their own lives. Her father drifts through a series of affairs, while her mother is immersed in republishing the erotic poems of her youth, neither fully grasping the urgency of the situation. Elsa’s return draws the three women into a confrontation with what still binds them, despite everything.
